In contract, within the final 30 days: you can leave at any time after the last day of your contract (even if you give notice less than 30 days before the contract end date)

Out of contract: If you are out of contract with us, you'll simply be moved onto to our fairly-priced Variable tariff (we don't believe in expensive out of contract rates).
